gaps.sentence: We found ___ that the flight had been cancelled.
It's time you faced up ___ your responsibilities.
gaps.explanation: face up TO something = accept and deal with something difficult.

gaps.sentence: The match was called ___ because of the storm.
We've decided to do ___ a holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: do without = manage without having something.

gaps.sentence: I fell ___ with my best friend over a silly remark.
gaps.explanation: fall out (with somebody) = have an argument and stop being friendly.

gaps.sentence: Lawyers are drawing ___ the contract now.
gaps.explanation: draw up = prepare and write (a contract, list, plan).

gaps.sentence: The talks fell ___ when neither side would compromise on fishing rights.
gaps.explanation: 'Fall through' = (a plan or deal) fail to be completed.

gaps.sentence: Hold ___ a moment — I'll check if he's in.
gaps.explanation: hold on = wait (especially on the phone).
